categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Jingyi Automation Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor-specific equipment. Its main product lines include semiconductor dedicated temperature control equipment (Chiller), semiconductor dedicated process exhaust gas treatment equipment (LocalScrubber), and wafer handling equipment (Sorter). These products serve critical steps in integrated circuit manufacturing, including logic chips and 3DNAND storage chips production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies such as advanced refrigeration control, precise temperature control, and energy-saving techniques for temperature control devices. It also independently developed low-temperature plasma exhaust gas treatment, corrosion-resistant sealing materials, and combustion technologies for exhaust gas processing. For wafer handling, it has proprietary technologies including automatic centering algorithms, wafer flipping, and micro-contact transmission. The company follows a rigorous R&D process from pre-research to production introduction, emphasizing innovation and iterative product improvement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic integrated circuit manufacturers such as Yangtze Memory Technologies, Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (SMIC), Hua Hong Group, Guangzhou Yuexin, and Changxin. The company serves the semiconductor manufacturing industry, focusing on logic and storage chip production lines, and has begun expanding into the broader semiconductor and display panel sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within mainland China, with its headquarters in Beijing and an industrial base in Anhui province. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Japan (BAEC JAPAN Co., Ltd.) focused on sales, technical support, and material procurement. The company’s products are mainly deployed in domestic semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Jingyi Automation Equipment Co., Ltd. operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in manufacturing and supplying critical semiconductor production equipment. It procures raw materials and components from suppliers, some of which perform custom processing based on company designs, and delivers finished equipment directly to semiconductor manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes independent innovation and continuous R&D investment, focusing on advancing core technologies in temperature control, exhaust gas treatment, and wafer handling. It aims to develop multi-channel, large-load, full-temperature range chillers, enhance combustion and plasma technologies for exhaust treatment, and improve automation and control algorithms for wafer handling. Collaborations with academic institutions and participation in national key projects support its strategic R&D initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor-specific equipment, including temperature control devices, exhaust gas treatment systems, and wafer handling machines. The company employs a direct sales model, engaging customers through negotiations and bidding, and also provides after-sales services such as installation, maintenance, and technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international semiconductor equipment giants that dominate the global market, especially in wafer handling and exhaust gas treatment segments. However, it has broken foreign monopolies in temperature control and exhaust gas treatment equipment within China, establishing itself as a leading domestic supplier with technology at a domestic leading and internationally advanced level. It faces competition from both established global players and emerging domestic companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.03 billion, representing a 38.28% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 152.9 million, up 28.35%. Total assets grew by 41.38% to RMB 4.04 billion, and net assets increased by 7.27% to RMB 2.07 billion. The company maintains a healthy growth trajectory supported by expanding market demand and successful new customer acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong independent R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and ability to provide customized solutions that meet diverse customer needs in advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes. Its products offer high precision, energy efficiency, and reliability, supporting critical manufacturing steps for logic and storage chips. The company also highlights its stable customer relationships, responsive local service teams, and commitment to breaking foreign technology monopolies to promote domestic semiconductor equipment self-sufficiency.
